title: Commit Athens 2: A Free Evening Hackathon
summary: Commit Athens 2 is a compact, free evening hackathon organised by students in Athens. Participants are randomly assigned into teams of five and have three and a half hours to build a working prototype using any tools they like. The event concludes with each team presenting their creation in a quick five-minute demo.
